name: seo-fieldset
title: SEO fieldset
description: Page title and description fields with a live search-result preview and a length meter that turns to words before text would be cut off.
docs: Give it baseUrl and control it with value ({ title, description, slug }) and onValueChange, or defaultValue. Lengths are counted in characters as a person sees them (an emoji is one) after runs of spaces are collapsed, against titleLimit (60) and descriptionLimit (160); titleMin (30) and descriptionMin (70) start the recommended range. The meter turns to 'Too long, cut off at 60' with a warning icon, and only a change of state is announced, never every keystroke. The preview cuts the text after exactly the limit and closes it with an ellipsis; an empty field shows fallbackTitle or fallbackDescription in grey, so it is never blank. The address line is built from baseUrl and the slug; editSlug adds a field for the slug, tidied to lower case and hyphens when you leave it. name sends the fields with a form, locale sets how characters are counted, labels translates the words.
